review.description: S4/S5 gain manifest-phase observation with truthful success/0, validation failure/1 and interruption/130 or numeric SystemExit status. Dispatcher identity is inherited from merged PR32; hosted setup/finalization/upload remain PR30 scope.

A missing journal bypasses only observation; observe catches ordinary start/stop exceptions so the validator and its result remain authoritative. The target bootstrap filtering before interruptible version collection and bounded test wrappers are retained unchanged. Rebased comparison is current main 96714fd; the only authored differences remain ci.py, its two manifest tests and their flow mappings.
review.tests: Inspected both added integration tests: real Git comparison, package provenance and Journal exercise success and unexpected-artifact failure; exactly one phase has ordered non-null timing fields and correct status. Cancellation executes real package validation then asserts the identical KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit143 and completed interrupted interval. Existing helper tests cover ordinary observation failure/privacy, injected-clock durations and bounded records; target dispatcher tests cover comparison preservation and root inventory. Mappings and rendered references retain their actual fixture-owned finalization descriptions; no hard-termination or hosted upload claim is made.
